label: Grounded thinking cone member has a distinct earlier thinking ancestor
term: no-fresh-thinker condition in one actual cone
definition: NoFreshThinkerInCone m w Occurs Bears b says: for every x in the complete actual concrete ground cone of b, if x bears an occurring thought and at least one actual concrete G edge enters x, then P(x) is true in the mediate strict-thinking-ancestor sense. It does not say that every immediate G-parent thinks, nor that a thinker cannot have nonthinking contributors, nor that any G edge itself is productive existential support.
note: Open analyst hypothesis in #1791, not a consequence of idealism or of the Cogito. The formal counter-interpretation q→b with q nonthinking and b thinking satisfies ¬P(b) while b has a G-parent, so the no-fresh premise excludes exactly that mechanism when b is in the selected cone. This is a conditional mathematical separation, not independent evidence against physicalist or emergence accounts. Positive warrant and matched-scope rivals belong to #1792.
